item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 02/Mar/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon now bringing cold weather to southern China will be gradually replaced by a relatively humid southerly airstream on Monday and Tuesday. It will be warm during the day and misty with a few showers over the coastal areas of Guangdong. Another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach Guangdong on Wednesday. It will be windier with temperatures dropping slightly over the coastal areas in the latter part of next week.
